candidates.title: BOOST: Concurrent Access to Host Memory and HBM to Accelerate LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Wave-aware page placement/runtime enables concurrent proportional host-memory+HBM bandwidth use without kernel changes; vLLM/Grace-Hopper evaluation reports 31% average throughput gain. Directly relevant to hierarchical memory/offload systems.

candidates.title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction
candidates.reason: Streaming 35B-class MoE inference from SSD using one-token-ahead trained routing prediction; directly targets SSD expert offload and reports 20 tok/s with ~3 GiB peak active memory on a 24GB machine.

candidates.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
candidates.reason: MLX runtime combines compressed KV execution, component residency switching, and state-preserving transitions to extend local long-context serving under tight memory capacity; strong on-device systems relevance.

candidates.title: GroupKV: Hierarchical KV Cache Management for Long-Context Diffusion LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Hierarchical KV management for diffusion LLMs with coarse-to-fine sparse selection, predictive prefetch, staleness correction and streaming prefill; reports up to 3.73x end-to-end speedup in offload settings.

candidates.title: Cache-Aware Joint Router Adaptation for Memory-Efficient MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Joint post-training of MoE and lightweight cache routers targets expert-cache hit rate/traffic while preserving Top-K routing; Qwen3/GPT-OSS evaluation reports substantial traffic reductions.
